description: Repairs r-fmt-2-pres-1/scalar-admission: the three Decimal writes (12345678901234.5678, -0.0001, VT_CY 1.5) went onto Sc.Fm made by CreateField(name, 20) (Precision 38, Scale 0), so every refusal (0x800A0EAF) describes that column and maps no precision or scale. Asks the same three admissions on Sc2.Fm, a DECIMAL(18,4) column made by ADO DDL: 12345678901234.5678 and -0.0001 as SQL INSERT literals (IDs 1 and 2, dbFailOnError, DBEngine.Errors after each), and VT_CY 1.5 through a table-type recordset AddNew/Value/Update (ID 3, DBEngine.Errors after the put and the update). The field's properties and the stored values (DAO, SQL CStr) are read back before and after. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes its mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
